situation: After a deployment to Hetzner, the bot failed to start. All environment variables were missing — the .env file had been wiped during a git operation.
root_cause: A `git checkout` or `git reset` during the deployment process removed the .env file even though it was in .gitignore. The exact trigger was unclear but likely involved a force pull.
solution: Re-provisioned the entire .env file from backup records. Added a pre-deployment step to always `cp .env .env.backup` before any git operations on the production server.
lesson: ALWAYS backup .env before any git operation on production. Even with .gitignore, git operations can wipe untracked files in certain edge cases. Keep a master credential sheet offline.

user_feedback.comments: Took 2 hours to fully re-provision all keys. Never again.
